components.name: Primary outline button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-label, "Bricolage Grotesque", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--color-primary, #3a54a4); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #3a54a4) 5%, transparent); border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #3a54a4) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #3a54a4) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #3a54a4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filled primary button
components.description: Newsletter submit and strong primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-filled { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: var(--font-label, "Bricolage Grotesque", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--color-on-primary, #ffffff); background: var(--color-primary, #3a54a4); border: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #3a54a4); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-filled:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #3a54a4) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #3a54a4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-filled:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Email field
components.description: Mailing-list email input — full pill on Page White (surface-container-lowest).
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 100%; } .ds-field-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); border: 0; } .ds-input-email { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: var(--font-body, "Be Vietnam Pro", sans-serif); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-on-surface, #232323); background: var(--color-surface-container-lowest, #ffffff); border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-outline-variant, #b8c4cb) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-input-email::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-on-surface-variant, #41484e) 60%, transparent); } .ds-input-email:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #3a54a4); } .ds-input-email:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #3a54a4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.html: beOIContestFAQ

components.name: Lab link (chrome)
components.description: External Lab CTA on the blue nav with mint flask accent via --color-lab-mint.
components.html: Lab
components.css: .ds-lab-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-on-chrome, #ffffff) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-on-chrome, #ffffff) 12%, transparent); color: var(--color-on-chrome, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-label, "Bricolage Grotesque", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-lab-flask { color: var(--color-lab-mint, #7dffc4); transition: filter 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-lab-link:hover, .ds-lab-link:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-on-chrome, #ffffff) 22%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-on-chrome, #ffffff) 55%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-lab-mint, #7dffc4) 35%, transparent); } .ds-lab-link:hover .ds-lab-flask, .ds-lab-link:focus-visible .ds-lab-flask { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-lab-mint, #7dffc4) 70%, transparent)); } .ds-lab-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lab-mint, #7dffc4); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-lab-link:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-lab-link:hover .ds-lab-flask, .ds-lab-link:focus-visible .ds-lab-flask { transform: rotate(30deg); } }

narrative.overview:
beOI’s public site should feel like a well-kept contest sketchbook for ages 10–18: playful enough to invite curiosity, clear enough that a pupil or teacher can see how to join. Cool grey craft-paper pages carry the story; Contest Blue chrome frames navigation and footer like a notebook cover; step illustrations and light hand-drawn wobble supply personality without tipping into cartoon chaos.

Density stays open and readable — generous page margins, alternating white and craft-paper bands, one job per section. Interaction is lightly kinetic (hover lift, Lab flask tilt) but always gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. The system rejects corporate SaaS chrome, paid-product urgency, dark “cyber olympiad” tropes, and anything that talks down to teenagers.
keyCharacteristics: Contest Blue brand + cool craft-paper surfaces
Three UI type faces (headline / body / label) plus system mono for code only
Flat-by-default depth (tone, borders, texture over shadows)
Full-pill CTAs and meta chips; thick quiet borders
Mascot step art as the visual signature of the journey

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Contest Blue is the only brand accent that may dominate a viewport (chrome, primary CTAs, key links). Green and amber are supporting voices.

rules.name: The Error Is Failure Rule
rules.body: #ba1a1a appears only for destructive or form-failure states — never as decoration.

rules.name: The Quiet Border Rule
rules.body: Structural lines use outline neutrals, not primary blue.

rules.name: The Lab Mint Contract Rule
rules.body: Lab mint exists only for the Lab link accent. Use --color-lab-mint / --color-lab-mint-deep (or the named tokens), never as a general brand or decorative fill.

rules.name: The Three-Face (+ Code Mono) Rule
rules.body: Three UI faces remain: Headlines → Plus Jakarta; reading → Be Vietnam Pro; chrome/UI → Bricolage. Mono is a fourth specialized role for code only (system ui-monospace stack on competitive-programming pages). Do not invent additional families for decoration — and do use mono for code.

rules.name: The Band Alternation Rule
rules.body: Long pages breathe by alternating craft-paper (background / surface #ececec) and Page White (surface-container-lowest #ffffff) full-bleed bands — not by stacking cards. White bands use the surface-system white token (bg-surface-container-lowest / var(--color-surface-container-lowest)), not raw Tailwind bg-white. Craft-paper surface stays #ececec; do not rename it to white.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest. Shadows appear only for transient UI (menus) or intentional stamp effects — not for every container.

rules.name: The Pill CTA Rule
rules.body: Primary actions and email fields are full pills. Rectangular sharp cards are not the default container language.

dos: Do keep Contest Blue as the sole dominant brand accent and match illustration blue.
Do alternate craft-paper (background/surface) and Page White (surface-container-lowest) bands on long pages — use the surface token, not raw bg-white.
Do use full-pill CTAs/inputs and quiet 2px borders.
Do gate motion behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Do preserve mascot step art and beOI logos as identity assets.
Do use var(--color-lab-mint) / var(--color-lab-mint-deep) for Lab accents, and the system mono stack for code.
donts: Don't make it feel like corporate SaaS, a paid product funnel, or dark cyber UI.
Don't tip into toddler-cartoon chaos (overuse of wobble, stickers, or rainbow accents).
Don't invent an extra decorative UI font family or load remote font CDNs (mono for code is the only specialized exception).
Don't use error red or Lab mint as general decoration.
Don't default to card grids with layered shadows for content that belongs in open bands.
Don't paint white bands with raw bg-white when bg-surface-container-lowest is the tokenized Page White.
